resources.string: Controls touch gestures, text input and screenshots on the XR display. Screenshots are saved on this phone; screen content is not sent over a network.
Connect your glasses to use the external desktop and touchpad.
Connection lost. Reconnect your glasses to continue.
Enable accessibility in Settings to use the touchpad.
Required for touchpad controls, text input and screenshots. Leave it enabled for everyday use.
Allows the app menu to float over the external app. If the system blocks it, a separate menu opens on the external display.

Main area: move or tap with one finger; hold to drag. Use two fingers to scroll.
Top-left corner: tap to exit. Phone Back also exits.
Bottom strip, left third: tap for recent apps.
Bottom strip, right two thirds: tap for external Back (root required).
Main area, four-finger tap: capture the external display.
To enter text, return to Home.
On startup, open the desktop only if no external app is detected. Keep the screen unchanged if an app is open or its status is unknown.
Try to reopen the last app after reconnecting. Keep any app already open; do not enter the phone touchpad automatically.
Reset desktop and touchpad settings, and clear favorites and recent history? The last app, language and text draft will be kept.
Clear recent history? Apps will stay open, and the last app record will be kept.
An external desktop, controlled from your phone.
Copyright holder: Ckar. Third-party components retain their own copyrights and licenses. Those licenses do not license the XR Desktop source code.
Settings and app history stay on this phone. Screenshots are saved to Pictures/XRDesktop. Failed text sends keep your draft. Accessibility is used for external controls, text input and screenshots.
